name: dayflow
description: Dayflow HRMS — React frontend and a local TypeScript + SQLite API.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors green,blue "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && node --experimental-strip-types frontend/src/lib/salary.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types frontend/src/lib/team.test.ts
scripts.check: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run build
